title: contracts/rtl.json
description: The app's facts about layout direction, read by rtl-and-direction's check-rtl. Every key is optional.

directionSource.description: Who decides the layout direction. "app" (default): an in-app language choice, through src/i18n/direction.ts and DirectionGate. "device": the app only follows the device language and keeps no restart machinery; direction-module and direction-before-render are not checked and expo-localization may set supportsRTL.

rootLayout.description: The file that renders DirectionGate first: the Expo Router root layout (default <routesDir>/_layout.tsx), or App.tsx with React Navigation.

startupCalls.description: Functions with effects (database open, migrations, hydration) that must run inside DirectionGate's children, never in the component that renders the gate.

gateWrappers.description: JSX elements without effects that may sit around DirectionGate in the root layout (default: Fragment, React.Fragment, GestureHandlerRootView, SafeAreaProvider; not StrictMode, which would run AppRoot's startup initializer twice in development). Any other element there mounts before the direction is decided.

outsideRoots.description: Files that render text outside the app's providers (a custom splash, a second root). The root layout's ErrorBoundary (its Fallback component, the one component it returns, or its inline JSX) is found without listing it.

physicalSurfaces.description: Component names that must stay left to right: each JSX use sits inside <PhysicalDirectionView> in the same file.

iconSet.description: The file that defines ICON_PATHS and DIRECTIONAL_ICONS.

iconComponent.description: The Icon component, the one place a scaleX: -1 flip may live.

directionalIcons.description: Icon names that point along the reading direction; DIRECTIONAL_ICONS must equal those that exist.

textPrimitive.description: The one file that may import Text from react-native (AppText).

textStyleHook.description: The one file that may set writingDirection (the design system's text style hook).

bidiFiles.description: Files allowed to hold bidi control characters or their escapes.
